help.faq.cycle-record-period.question: Amek ara smedeɣ lḥiḍ-iw?
help.faq.cycle-record-period.subtitle: Rnu iwennaten d teɣzi n lḥiḍ-ik.
help.faq.cycle-record-period.answer: Deg uwennaz neɣ deg Umeɣrad n ass, sred melmi i yebda lḥiḍ-ik, acḥal i yettɣimi, d tezmert n usuḍu. Talɣut-a tebna amazray-ik udmawan, tettekki deg uḍfar i d-yettwasken deg AWA.
help.faq.cycle-edit-period.question: Zemreɣ ad ssenfareɣ azemz n lḥiḍ?
help.faq.cycle-edit-period.subtitle: Ṣeḥḥ azemz ma yettubeddel uḍfar-ik.
help.faq.cycle-edit-period.answer: Ih. Ẓreg azemz yellan deg uḍfar-ik akken amazray-ik ad yili yemṣaḥ d tawaɣit-ik tilawant. Isnaw zemren ad beddlen s tmuɣli n talɣut tamaynut i yettwakelsen.
help.faq.cycle-predictions.question: Amek yettwahseb lḥiḍ-iw i d-yettasen?
help.faq.cycle-predictions.subtitle: Isnaw i yebnan ɣef umazray-ik udmawan.
help.faq.cycle-predictions.answer: AWA tesnaw lḥiḍ-ik i d-yettasen, tamnaḍt-ik n tuẓẓalt d ovulation seg umazray-ik udmawan, teɣzi n tawaɣit-ik d talɣut i tesmeḍ. Isnaw ur d-ttbanen ara kan ɣef tawaɣit n 28 n wussan.
help.faq.cycle-flow.question: Amek ara ḍfareɣ tezmert n usuḍu?
help.faq.cycle-flow.subtitle: Sred amek i yettubeddil usuḍu.
help.faq.cycle-flow.answer: Seqdec Ameɣrad n ass i usmed n tezmert n usuḍu n lḥiḍ. Ayagi ihelles amazray n wamek i yettubeddil gar tiwaɣitin.
help.faq.cycle-calendar.question: Acu i d-yeqqaren yiceggiɛen n uwennaz?
help.faq.cycle-calendar.subtitle: Lḥiḍ, tuẓẓalt, ovulation d uwennaz Hijri.
help.faq.cycle-calendar.answer: Awennaz isken ussan n lḥiḍ i tesmeḍ ula d tamnaḍt-ik n tuẓẓalt d ovulation i yettwamḍen. Ma ttwaseddhen yiceggiɛen iṛuḥanin, azemz Hijri izmer ad d-yettwaskan ula d azemz Grigoryan.
help.faq.conceive-fertile-window.questio: Amek ara issneɣ tamnaḍt-iw n tuẓẓalt?
help.faq.conceive-fertile-window.subtitl: Wali ussan i yettwamḍen d igerrzen n tuẓẓalt.
help.faq.conceive-fertile-window.answer: Deg uskar Ɛerḍeɣ ad ḥemleɣ, AWA tesken tamnaḍt n tuẓẓalt i yettwamḍen, ibnan ɣef talɣut n tawaɣit-ik d umazray-ik udmawan.
help.faq.conceive-ovulation.question: Amek yettwamḍen ovulation-iw?
help.faq.conceive-ovulation.subtitle: Amḍan i yettubeddilen mi ara ḍefreḍ.
help.faq.conceive-ovulation.answer: Ovulation yettwamḍen seg talɣut yellan deg umazray n tawaɣit-ik. Amḍan-a izmer ad yettubeddel mi ara tzeyyeḍ isefka imaynuten.
help.faq.conceive-temperature.question: Zemreɣ ad ḍfareɣ tazeggwaɣt-iw tazadurt?
help.faq.conceive-temperature.subtitle: Rnu tazeggwaɣt-ik ɣer uḍfar-ik n tuẓẓalt.
help.faq.conceive-temperature.answer: Ih. Uḍfar n tzeggwaɣt tazadurt yella deg uskar ibaḍnen n lḥemla.
help.faq.conceive-cervical-mucus.subtitl: Rnu aɛessi-a ɣer uḍfar-ik n tuẓẓalt.
help.faq.conceive-cervical-mucus.answer: Ih. Uḍfar n cervical mucus d yiwen seg yisefka yellan deg uskar Ɛerḍeɣ ad ḥemleɣ.
help.faq.conceive-lh-test.question: Zemreɣ ad smedeɣ uzmel n ovulation LH?
help.faq.conceive-lh-test.subtitle: Eḥfeḍ igmaḍ-ik deg uḍfar-ik.
help.faq.conceive-lh-test.answer: Ih. Asmed n yizmal n ovulation LH yella deg webrid n lḥemla.
help.faq.conceive-intercourse.question: Amek ara smedeɣ taggara n tmeɣra?
help.faq.conceive-intercourse.subtitle: Tafekka tuḥeṛmit deg umeɣrad-ik.
help.faq.conceive-intercourse.answer: Aseggas n Tuḥeṛmit yeǧǧa-k ad tsmeḍ taɣuri d talɣut-nniḍen yettwaqqnen. Aseggas-a yeqqim d uffir u izmer ad yettwaḥrez s wudem ibaḍnen.
help.faq.contraception-method.question: Acu n tarrayin n contraception i zemreɣ ad ḍfareɣ?
help.faq.contraception-method.subtitle: Tikeččumin, tahri, patch d wuzìdi n hormone.
help.faq.contraception-method.answer: AWA tesdukkel uḍfar n tkeččumt n contraception, tahri n tebbaɣt, patch n contraception, d yizìdiyen-nniḍen n hormone.
help.faq.contraception-pill-reminder.que: Zemreɣ ad sbeddeɣ asmekti i tkeččumt-iw?
help.faq.contraception-pill-reminder.sub: Sbedd ismektiyen i yezmer ad ttwaleqqmen.
help.faq.contraception-pill-reminder.ans: Ih. AWA tettak ismektiyen ileqqmen i uṭṭaf n tkeččumt-ik, akked ilɣa n yal ass.
help.faq.contraception-forgotten-pill.qu: Zemreɣ ad smedeɣ tkeččumt i d-nsiɣ?
help.faq.contraception-forgotten-pill.an: Ih. Uḍfar n tikkal i d-nsiɣ yella deg webrid n contraception.
help.faq.contraception-history.question: Anda ara naf amazray n uṭṭaf-iw?
help.faq.contraception-history.subtitle: Wali tikkal i tesmeḍ d tkeččumin i d-nsiɣ.
help.faq.contraception-history.answer: Illa umazray n uṭṭaf i uhelles n uḍfar-ik n contraception.
help.faq.contraception-predictions.quest: Isnaw mazal-iten d iwulmen deg contraception?
help.faq.contraception-predictions.subti: Kra n tarrayin zemrent ad beddlent tawaɣit-ik tazadurt.
help.faq.contraception-predictions.answe: AWA tezmer ad d-teskkeb talɣut n uḍfar yellan, maca amek ara tefhmeḍ isnaw ittṛaǧu ɣef waddad-ik d tarrayt-ik. Asnas ur isuḍel ara uwellih n ṭṭbib.
help.faq.irregular-long-cycle.question: Tawaɣit tameqqrant tettwaḥseb d "tǧehhel"?
help.faq.irregular-long-cycle.subtitle: AWA tettwali tiwaɣitin ur nṣeḥḥ ara.
help.faq.irregular-long-cycle.answer: Ala. Deg uskar SOPK/Tiwaɣitin ur nṣeḥḥ ara, AWA ur tḥessib ara s wudem awurman tawaɣit tameqqrant d "tǧehhel".
help.faq.irregular-symptoms.question: Acu n tsekkiwin i zemreɣ ad ḍfareɣ s PCOS?
help.faq.irregular-symptoms.subtitle: Ẓẓer tisekkiwin i yettubeddilen s wakud.
help.faq.irregular-symptoms.answer: Uḍfar yesɛa tiwaɣitin ur nṣeḥḥ ara, ibexxan, tirni n yiziwen, ibeddilen n lweznan d tsekkiwin yettwaqqnen.
help.faq.irregular-acne-hair.question: Zemreɣ ad ḍfareɣ ibexxan d tirni n yiziwen?
help.faq.irregular-acne-hair.subtitle: Rnu iẓriyen ɣer uḍfar-ik n PCOS.
help.faq.irregular-acne-hair.answer: Ih. Ibexxan d tirni n yiziwen llan s wudem ubanen deg uḍfar yettwaḍman i PCOS.
help.faq.irregular-weight.question: Zemreɣ ad ḍfareɣ ibeddilen n lweznan-iw?
help.faq.irregular-weight.subtitle: Ẓẓer amek i yettubeddil lweznan-ik s wakud.
help.faq.irregular-weight.answer: Ih. Uḍfar n lweznan yella deg uskar PCOS/Tiwaɣitin ur nṣeḥḥ ara.
help.faq.irregular-predictions.question: Acuɣer i ttubeddilen waṭas isnaw-iw?
help.faq.irregular-predictions.subtitle: Tiwaɣitin ur nṣeḥḥ ara ttarrant isnaw ur ṭṭafaren ara.
help.faq.irregular-predictions.answer: Mi ara tilint tiwaɣitin ur nṣeḥḥ ara, isnaw zemren ad beddlen s waṭas. AWA tesseqdac amazray-ik udmawan war ma tḥessib s wudem awurman tawaɣit tameqqrant d tǧehhel.
help.faq.menopause-symptoms.question: Acu n tsekkiwin i zemreɣ ad ḍfareɣ?
help.faq.menopause-symptoms.subtitle: Uḍfar yettwasuqel i ibeddilen n uzgen-a n tmeddurt.
help.faq.menopause-symptoms.answer: Uḍfar yesɛa hot flashes, tidwiyin n yiḍ, uguren n yiṣṭṭan, taɛeggunt, ibeddilen n wannuz d usemmiḍ n uɣerbaz, d wayen-nniḍen.
help.faq.menopause-hot-flashes.question: Zemreɣ ad smedeɣ hot flashes-iw?
help.faq.menopause-hot-flashes.subtitle: Ẓẓer tiɣuri-nsent s wakud.
help.faq.menopause-hot-flashes.answer: Ih. Hot flashes d yiwet seg tsekkiwin yellan deg uskar Perimenopause/Menopause.
help.faq.menopause-sleep.question: Zemreɣ ad ḍfareɣ yiṣṭṭan-iw d taɛeggunt?
help.faq.menopause-sleep.subtitle: Ẓẓer uguren n yiṣṭṭan d taɛeggunt.
help.faq.menopause-sleep.answer: Ih. Uguren n yiṣṭṭan, tidwiyin n yiḍ d taɛeggunt llan akk deg webrid-a.
help.faq.menopause-hormonal-treatment.qu: Zemreɣ ad ḍfareɣ uzìdi n hormone?
help.faq.menopause-hormonal-treatment.an: Ih. Tzemreḍ ad ḍfareḍ izìdiyen n hormone deg uskar-a.
help.faq.menopause-labs.question: Zemreɣ ad smedeɣ igmaḍ-iw n FSH d estradiol?
help.faq.menopause-labs.subtitle: Rnu kra n yigmaḍ n lmuxtabar ɣer uḍfar-ik.
help.faq.menopause-labs.answer: Ih. Igmaḍ n lmuxtabar am FSH d estradiol zemren ad ttwasmed deg uskar-a.
help.faq.pregnancy-due-date.question: Amek yettwahseb wass n tlalit-iw?
help.faq.pregnancy-due-date.subtitle: Amḍan i d-yettwaskan deg uḍfar-ik n lḥemla.
help.faq.pregnancy-due-date.answer: Uḍfar n lḥemla yesenhseb azemz-ik n tlalit i yettwamḍen seg talɣut yellan deg uḍfar-ik.
help.faq.pregnancy-weekly.question: Zemreɣ ad ḍfareɣ lḥemla-w dduṛt ɣer dduṛt?
help.faq.pregnancy-weekly.subtitle: Ẓẓer ibrid n lḥemla-ik dduṛt ɣer dduṛt.
help.faq.pregnancy-weekly.answer: Ih. AWA tettak uḍfar dduṛt ɣer dduṛt u tesken amek i tettemẓi lḥemla-ik.
help.faq.pregnancy-appointments.question: Zemreɣ ad smedeɣ isulayen-iw imudemmen?
help.faq.pregnancy-appointments.subtitle: Eḥfeḍ isulayen-ik yesɛan azal deg yiwen n umkan.
help.faq.pregnancy-appointments.answer: Ih. Isulayen imudemmen d yinagaren yesɛan azal llan deg uḍfar n lḥemla.
help.faq.pregnancy-reminders.question: Zemreɣ ad ɣreɣ ismektiyen i yinagaren-iw?
help.faq.pregnancy-reminders.subtitle: Sbedd ismektiyen uslig.
help.faq.pregnancy-reminders.answer: Ih. Llan ismektiyen uslig i isulayen d yinagaren yesɛan azal.
help.faq.pregnancy-journal.question: Acu i zemreɣ ad ḍfareɣ deg lḥemla-w?
help.faq.pregnancy-journal.subtitle: Tisekkiwin, lweznan, wannuz, yiṣṭṭan d talɣut tudmawant.
help.faq.pregnancy-journal.answer: Uḍfar n lḥemla izmer ad yesɛu tisekkiwin i tḥissiseḍ, lweznan, wannuz, yiṣṭṭan d talɣut tudmawant n ṭṭb.
help.faq.postpartum-lochia.question: Amek ara ḍfareɣ lochia-w?
help.faq.postpartum-lochia.subtitle: Ẓẓer teɣzi d wamek i yettubeddil usuḍu.
help.faq.postpartum-lochia.answer: Uḍfar n deffir tlalit yesɛa teɣzi n lochia, amek i yettubeddil usuḍu, d tsekkiwin yettwaqqnen.
help.faq.postpartum-cycle-return.questio: Amek ara ḍfareɣ tuɣalin n lḥiḍ-iw?
help.faq.postpartum-cycle-return.answer: AWA tḍfar tuɣalin n tawaɣit-ik, tuɣalin n lḥiḍ-ik, d ibeddilen n hormone-ik deffir tlalit.
help.faq.postpartum-breastfeeding.questi: Zemreɣ ad ḍfareɣ ɣer wudem n usfuddu d amenorrhea n usfuddu?
help.faq.postpartum-breastfeeding.subtit: Eḥfeḍ talɣut-a deg webrid-ik n deffir tlalit.
help.faq.postpartum-breastfeeding.answer: Ih. Asfuddu d amenorrhea n deffir tlalit llan deg uḍfar yellan.
help.faq.postpartum-recovery.question: Acu i zemreɣ ad ḍfareɣ deg uɣilif-iw?
help.faq.postpartum-recovery.subtitle: Taɛeggunt, yiṣṭṭan, wannuz, ugrir d uɣilif n ugarur.
help.faq.postpartum-recovery.answer: Uḍfar n yal ass n deffir tlalit yesɛa taɛeggunt, yiṣṭṭan, wannuz, ugrir d uɣilif n ugarur, d wayen-nniḍen.
help.faq.postpartum-nifas.question: Amek i tettwali AWA nifas?
help.faq.postpartum-nifas.subtitle: Aceggeɛ ṛuḥani, i yemgaraden seg uḍfar n ṭṭb.
help.faq.postpartum-nifas.answer: Ma ttwaseddhen yiceggiɛen iṛuḥanin, AWA tezmer ad tḍfar teɣzi n idammen n deffir tlalit u tesken tagnit n nifas almend n ubadu ṛuḥani i yettwafren. Teɣzi tameqqrant tezmer ad temgarad gar tmedrasin n uẓar u ur d-tettwasken ara am tideț yiwen mi ara temgaradent tmuɣliwin.
help.faq.loss-bleeding.question: Amek ara ḍfareɣ idammen-iw?
help.faq.loss-bleeding.subtitle: Ẓẓer amek i d-ttuɣal, war ma tkeččmeḍ s tazzla ɣer uḍfar amagnu.
help.faq.loss-bleeding.answer: Webrid Deffir tuffɣa n lḥemla yeḍfar idammen d wamek i d-ttuɣal, deg umkan yettwasuqel i tallit-a.
help.faq.loss-cycle-return.question: Amek ara ḍfareɣ tuɣalin n tawaɣit-iw?
help.faq.loss-cycle-return.subtitle: Kemmel uḍfar-ik s wazal-ik.
help.faq.loss-cycle-return.answer: AWA tḍfar tuɣalin n tawaɣit-ik deffir tuffɣa n lḥemla, tettaǧǧa-k ad tkemmleḍ amazray-ik ncc ncc war ma tessawḍeḍ s tazzla uḍfar amagnu n lḥiḍ.
help.faq.loss-symptoms.question: Acu n tsekkiwin i zemreɣ ad smedeɣ?
help.faq.loss-symptoms.subtitle: Ḍfer tisekkiwin n ugarur i tebɣiḍ ad tsmeḍ.
help.faq.loss-symptoms.answer: Uḍfar n tsekkiwin n ugarur yella deg webrid-a.
help.faq.loss-notes.question: Zemreɣ ad eḥfeḍeɣ tizmilin tudmawanin?
help.faq.loss-notes.subtitle: Amkan udmawan deg umeɣrad-ik.
help.faq.loss-notes.answer: Ih. Tizmilin tudmawanin llant i uḍfar-ik deg tallit-a.
help.faq.loss-conceive-again.question: Zemreɣ ad uɣaleɣ ɣer Ɛerḍeɣ ad ḥemleɣ ɣer deffir?
help.faq.loss-conceive-again.subtitle: Beddel iswi-ik melmi i tebɣiḍ ad tɛerḍeḍ i tikkelt-nniḍen.
help.faq.loss-conceive-again.answer: Tallalt i uɣalin ɣer iɛerḍen n lḥemla tella. Abeddel n iswi-ik yeqqim ncc ncc u yella yal tikkelt d afran-ik.
help.faq.spiritual-hijri.question: Amek i iteddu uwennaz Hijri?
help.faq.spiritual-hijri.subtitle: Isken azemz Hijri ula d azemz Grigoryan.
help.faq.spiritual-hijri.answer: Ma ttwaseddhen yiceggiɛen iṛuḥanin, AWA tezmer ad d-teskan azemz Hijri ula d azemz Grigoryan u tceggeɛ ayyuren yesɛan azal am Ramaḍan neɣ Ḏu lḥiǧǧa.
help.faq.spiritual-purity.question: Acu i d-yeqqar waddad n ṭṭhara?
help.faq.spiritual-purity.subtitle: Aceggeɛ uffir yettwaqqnen d tuɣalin ɣer tɛibadt.
help.faq.spiritual-purity.answer: AWA tezmer ad d-teskan aceggeɛ uffir i yemgaraden lḥiḍ-ik seg tallit-ik n ṭṭhara ma ttwaseddhen yiceggiɛen iṛuḥanin.
help.faq.spiritual-prayer-return.questio: Amek i d-tebder AWA melmi ara d-tuɣal tseddit?
help.faq.spiritual-prayer-return.subtitl: Aceggeɛ i yebnan ɣef taggara n lḥiḍ-ik.
help.faq.spiritual-prayer-return.answer: Ma d-tuɣal ṭṭhara send ad yemmet wakud n tseddit n tura, asnas izmer ad yeceggeɛ belli tseddit-a tuɣal d tanezzut. Tiseddiyin i d-nsiɣ deg lḥiḍ ur ttwaḥsabent ara d tiseddiyin i yessefk ad ttwaɛawden.
help.faq.spiritual-qadaa.question: Amek i iteddu uḍfar n ussan n uṣum i yessefk ad ttwaɛawden?
help.faq.spiritual-qadaa.subtitle: Ihseb ussan i d-nsiɣ ɣef lḥiḍ-ik.
help.faq.spiritual-qadaa.answer: AWA tezmer ad d-tefk amesḥab i ussan n uṣum i d-nsiɣ ɣef lḥiḍ-ik, ladɣa deg Ramaḍan, akked asmekti afessas deffir ayyur akken ad tsuddseḍ tuɣalin-nsen.
help.faq.spiritual-nifas.question: Amek i d-yettwasken nifas?
help.faq.spiritual-nifas.subtitle: Aceggeɛ i yezmer ad yemgarad gar tmedrasin n uẓar.
help.faq.spiritual-nifas.answer: AWA tezmer ad d-tesken abadu ṛuḥani i yettwafren i teɣzi tameqqrant n nifas, s usegzi n yemgaraden gar tmedrasin ma yella ugbur yettwasseḥḥen ad ten-yeṭṭef. Asnas ur d-tesken ara yiwen n wawal am tideț n tidet.
help.faq.spiritual-istihada.question: AWA tettak iwellihen ɣef istiḥaḍa?
help.faq.spiritual-istihada.subtitle: Agbur n usegmi, mačči fetwa tudmawant.
help.faq.spiritual-istihada.answer: AWA tezmer ad d-tefk agbur amatu n usegmi ɣef istiḥaḍa d wayen i tessuter deg tɛibadt. Asnas ur d-yettak ara fetwa tudmawant, u agbur ṛuḥani ilaq ad yettwasseḥḥ sɣur tallalt yettwassnen.
help.faq.journal-what-can-track.question: Acu i zemreɣ ad smedeɣ deg umeɣrad-iw?
help.faq.journal-what-can-track.subtitle: Tisekkiwin, wannuz, tuḥeṛmit, yiṣṭṭan d armud.
help.faq.journal-what-can-track.answer: Ameɣrad n ass yesɛa tisekkiwin n ugarur, waddad n wul, tuḥeṛmit, yiṣṭṭan, armud n ugarur, d tizmilin tudmawanin.
help.faq.journal-what-can-track.subtitle: Tisekkiwin, wannuz, yiṣṭṭan, armud, tisit, usuḍu n lḥiḍ d tizmilin.
help.faq.journal-what-can-track.answerDa: Ameɣrad n ass yeǧǧa-k ad ḍfareḍ tisekkiwin n ugarur, wannuz, yiṣṭṭan, armud n ugarur, tisit, usuḍu n lḥiḍ, d tizmilin tudmawanin.
help.faq.journal-intimacy.question: Aseggas-iw n Tuḥeṛmit izmer ad yettwaḥrez?
help.faq.journal-intimacy.subtitle: Aseggas uffir yemgaraden.
help.faq.journal-intimacy.answer: Ih. Aseggas n Tuḥeṛmit izmer ad yettwaffer u yettwaḥrez s PIN neɣ Face ID-is yemgaraden.
